rule: Each figure has one arrow of roughly equal length that starts at or very near a box edge (or just outside it) and points into the box, with the head ending inside the frame. Where a dashed line exists it lies about one third of the way along the arrow from its tail and is crossed by the shaft. Figure 4 is the only one whose arrowhead leaves the box, so it breaks the pattern.
options_check: 1: arrow starts at left edge, points right, head inside the box, fits. 2: arrow starts at top edge, points down, head inside, fits. 3: arrow starts at bottom edge, points up, head inside, fits. 4: tail is inside the box and the head sticks out past the top edge, so it does not fit. 5: tail starts just outside the bottom edge, head inside the box, fits.
redraw_diffs: Redraw matches the original in arrow directions, dashed-line positions, and the tail of 5 poking below the box and the head of 4 poking above. Only minor differences in stroke thickness and shadow (grey offset shadow omitted), none that would change the answer. Note the rule is uncertain: dashed lines appear only in 1, 3 and 4.
